skills.name: Convert to common denominator
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator and convert fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of fractions with a common denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its simplest form by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.

skills.name: Manage mixed numbers
skills.definition: Separate whole and fraction parts of mixed numbers, subtract whole numbers, borrow if necessary, and combine the results.
